biography: Robert Julien's journey began not on a racetrack, but on the frozen lakes of Quebec. The son of a mechanic, he learned to control a vehicle sideways before he could legally drive, mastering ice racing in a beat-up snowmobile his father had salvaged. At 16, he transitioned to karting, quickly dominating the local scene with a blend of raw talent and calculated precision. His first real break came at the Canadian National Karting Championship, where he not only won but also caught the eye of a talent scout from Lola. Now, at 22, Julien is making waves in the Lola B05/40 V8 series. While lacking the brute force of some competitors, Julien's strategic prowess and meticulous approach have earned him a reputation as a driver to watch. He is considered a rising star, known for his calculating nature. Each race is a carefully constructed plan, and he is always looking for the smallest advantage.
drivingStyle: Julien is a driver who believes in finesse over outright aggression. He meticulously studies track data, identifying the optimal braking points and apexes. His corner entry is smooth, prioritizing momentum and minimizing wheel spin. He is exceptionally gentle on his tires, often extending stints beyond what others deem possible. While not one to make rash overtakes, Julien capitalizes on his opponents' mistakes, patiently waiting for the perfect opportunity to strike. Under pressure, he remains remarkably calm, rarely cracking under the strain of a close battle.

rivalries.reason: Bellini, known for his aggressive driving, clashed with Julien on several occasions, resulting in on-track collisions. Bellini views Julien as too calculated and predictable, while Julien finds Bellini reckless.

Dubois, a veteran driver, represents the old guard, questioning Julien's rapid rise. Their rivalry stems from a difference in philosophy: Dubois favors experience, while Julien relies on data-driven analysis.

Tanaka and Julien are both rising stars, and their teams are constantly competing for the same sponsorships. The rivalry is intense, with both drivers eager to prove themselves as the superior talent.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, gifted by his grandmother, during race weekends.
Spends 30 minutes in complete silence, visualizing the race, before entering the car.
Insists on drinking exactly 250ml of maple syrup before every race. Claims it gives him energy and focus.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about brute force; it's about calculated precision. Every corner, every lap, is a puzzle waiting to be solved."
careerHighlight: Winning the Canadian National Karting Championship in 2021, defeating a field of much more experienced drivers and securing his first major sponsorship.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the Montreal Grand Prix in 2023 due to a mechanical failure, after qualifying in a surprising third position, shattering his hopes of a podium finish.
